description:
Cast Nadir Kraken by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Nadir Kraken enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat from step 5.
